16:The chapter sections below cover Lyn mode and Hector mode. Eliwood mode is not covered. Recruits are the same on normal and hard difficulty throughout the entire game, so use the list for your mode regardless of difficulty.
32:## Lyn mode
122:s05: WON on attempt 1 (survived to end of turn 7). No deaths. Dorcas RECRUITED turn 3 (Lyn talked from (7,5) when he stood at (7,6); he can act the same turn).
256:Seize gate (2,16) SW corner; boss general-type (cls16, 35HP D14, R7) sits on it. 11 enemies at start. Start NW; bridge (7,2) east, rivers cut the map. Village (15,12), houses (3,1),(16,2),(13,16), armory/vendor (12,15)/(11,15).
264:s12: WON on attempt 1, turn 24 (Lyn seized). No deaths, no recruits (none available). LYN'S TALE IS COMPLETE.
268:- Boss (cls16, D14 on the gate, castle at x1-3 y14-16): mage Lv6 kills the knight at (2,17) from (4,17), then chips the boss from (3,17) for 14 a turn. The boss only counters at range 2 once it switches to its javelin (16 dmg). Lyn's swords do 3.
270:- Ending: "Here ends Lyn's story. Save?" -> Yes, slot 1 (was Ch.10); it saved as "Ch.11: Taking Leave". Next came "Would you like to continue playing?" (Yes/No), which I LEFT UNANSWERED for the human, because Eliwood mode is not in this file.
